hero.title: Design training faster than content changes.

definition.en: The LearnPack Instructional Designer is an AI-powered assistant that generates complete training courses from source material, making regeneration faster and more cost effective than manual updates.

capabilities.title: The LearnPack Solution
capabilities.headline: Generate complete courses from any source material.
capabilities.body: LearnPack's AI analyzes your documents, slides, and content to create structured training automatically. When content changes, regenerate the entire course in minutes instead of spending days on manual updates.

regeneration.title: Instant course regeneration
regeneration.description: When your content changes, generate a new course in minutes instead of spending days on updates. Drop the old version and move on.

structure.title: AI-generated structure and assessments
structure.description: Automatic lesson sequencing, quiz generation, and knowledge checks. The AI applies proven instructional design principles every time.

editing.title: Notion-style editing for fast review
editing.description: Block-based editing lets you refine AI output quickly and intuitively. Make adjustments without navigating complex course builders.

localization.title: Automatic localization per generation
localization.description: Generate courses in multiple languages without separate workflows. Each regeneration can target a new language or region.

publishing.title: LMS-ready publishing
publishing.description: Export as SCORM, embed directly, or integrate with your existing systems. Deploy to any learning management system with one click.

examples.title: Real examples. From source to course in minutes.
examples.subtitle: See how teams transform their existing materials into interactive training.

testimonial.quote: LearnPack cut our course creation time from weeks to hours without losing quality.

control.question: Will I lose instructional control if courses are AI generated?
control.answer: No. The AI generates a complete draft, but you have full control to review, edit, and refine before publishing. The Notion-style editor makes adjustments fast and intuitive.

changes.question: How do teams handle frequent content changes?
changes.answer: Instead of patching existing courses, teams upload the updated source material and regenerate a new version. This is faster than editing and produces cleaner results.

lms.question: Does LearnPack work with our LMS?
lms.answer: Yes. LearnPack exports SCORM packages compatible with all major learning management systems. You can also embed courses directly or integrate via API.
